title: Specific charge expression
description: Essential: Correctly derives and states the final expression for q/m = (√3 v)/(3 B R).

title: Time in field expression
description: Essential: Correctly derives and states the final expression for t = (√3 π R)/(3 v).

title: Shift distance expression
description: Essential: Correctly derives and states the final expression for d = (√3 / 3) R.

title: Geometry for trajectory radius
description: Important: Uses the 60° deflection to relate the trajectory radius r to the region radius R (e.g., r = R / tan30° or equivalent).

title: Force balance application
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law with the magnetic Lorentz force providing centripetal force: qvB = mv²/r.

title: Time from motion fraction
description: Important: Recognizes the time in the field is a fraction (1/6) of the full cyclotron period T = 2πm/(qB).

title: Geometry for maximum deflection
description: Important: For part (3), establishes the condition for maximum deflection (e.g., sin θ = R/r or equivalent chord geometry).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns the sign of the charge in the force law or misinterprets the deflection direction.

title: Unit or algebraic mistake
description: Pitfall: Makes an algebraic error in combining the geometric relation with the force law, or omits/drops constants like π or √3.
